Definition: Chatsor, the name (thus simply) of two places in Palestine and of one in Arabia
BiblicalUsage: Hazor = "castle"; 1) a royal city of northern Palestine allotted to Naphtali; 2) one of the cities of Judah in the extreme south; 3) a town north of Jerusalem in which the Benjamites resided after the return from exile; 4) a site in Arabia
